family_guide.root_logic: 以 valance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿越市区的, 横越市区的
lemmas.def_en: going or extending across a town or city

examples.en: We took a crosstown bus to avoid the heavy traffic along the main avenue.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐横穿市区的公共汽车，以避开主干道上的拥堵交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crosstown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 普救论, 普遍性, 普遍特征
lemmas.def_en: the theological doctrine that all people will eventually be saved

examples.en: His political philosophy emphasizes universalism and the shared fundamental rights of all humanity.
examples.zh: 他的政治哲学强调普遍主义以及全人类共同的基本权利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 universalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous plants of the genus Asclepias having milky juice and pods that split open releasing seeds with downy tufts

examples.en: Monarch butterflies rely almost exclusively on milkweed plants to feed their growing caterpillars.
examples.zh: 黑脉金斑蝶几乎完全依靠马利筋植物来喂养正在生长的毛毛虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milkweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To catch or entangle someone or something in a net, or involve them deeply in an unpleasant or complicated situation.

examples.en: The diplomat feared being enmeshed in a prolonged and bitter regional conflict.
examples.zh: 这位外交官害怕自己深陷于一场旷日持久且激烈的地区冲突中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enmesh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （物理/化学）（通过吸收或吸附）吸纳，吸着
lemmas.def_en: [T] (chemistry, physics) To take up and hold a gas, liquid, or solute by either absorption or adsorption.

examples.en: The porous clay material can sorb harmful heavy metals directly from industrial wastewater.
examples.zh: 这种多孔粘土材料可以直接吸附工业废水中的有害重金属。

lemmas.def_en: the process in which one substance takes up or holds another (by either absorption or adsorption)
a material that sorbs another substance; i.e. that has the capacity or tendency to take it up by either absorption or adsorption
(of a substance) taken up and held by either adsorption or absorption
lemmas.usage_note: 属于化学与材料科学领域的专业术语，通常修饰分子、水分或化学物质，如 sorbed water（吸留水）。

examples.en: The amount of sorbed gas was measured under varying pressure conditions.
examples.zh: 在不同压力条件下测定了被吸附气体的量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sorb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 厌恶人类的人, 不愿与人来往者
lemmas.def_en: someone who dislikes people in general

examples.en: Living alone in the mountains, the old misanthrope avoided any contact with outsiders.
examples.zh: 那位隐居山中的孤僻老人极力避免与任何外界人士接触。

lemmas.def_zh: 厌恶人类, 不愿与人来往
lemmas.def_en: hatred of mankind

examples.en: After years of personal betrayal, his bitter misanthropy drove him into total solitude.
examples.zh: 在经历了多年的背叛后，强烈的厌世心理驱使他走向了彻底的隐居。

lemmas.def_zh: 厌恶人类的, 不愿与人来往的
lemmas.def_en: believing the worst of human nature and motives; having a sneering disbelief in e.g. selflessness of others

family_guide.root_logic: 以 misanthropy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使变性（改变天然性质）；使（酒精等）变性以不可饮用
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to alter the natural qualities or structure of a protein or other molecule. 2. [T] to add a toxic or foul-tasting substance to alcohol so it is unfit to drink.

examples.en: High cooking temperatures quickly denature proteins, altering their natural molecular structure permanently.
examples.zh: 烹饪时的高温会迅速使蛋白质变性，永久改变其天然分子结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a disappointing decline after a previous rise

examples.en: After months of intense public anticipation, the election result felt like an anticlimax.
examples.zh: 在公众数月的强烈期待之后，选举结果却令人感到虎头蛇尾。

lemmas.def_zh: 突降法的, 虎头蛇尾的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a sudden change from an impressive to a ludicrous style

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anticlimax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过度节俭, 吝啬, 惜墨如金
lemmas.def_en: extreme care in spending money; reluctance to spend money unnecessarily

examples.en: The company's extreme parsimony left the office with outdated computers and poor supplies.
examples.zh: 公司的极度吝啬导致办公室里尽是过时的电脑和劣质的办公用品。

lemmas.def_zh: 过度节俭的, 吝啬小气的
lemmas.def_en: excessively unwilling to spend

examples.en: parsimonious thrift relieved by few generous impulses
lived in a most penurious manner--denying himself every indulgence

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parsimony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 糖果制造人, 甜食商
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes candies and other sweets

examples.en: The local confectioner spent all morning crafting delicate chocolate truffles for the holiday.
examples.zh: 当地的糖果师花了一整个上午为节日制作精致的松露巧克力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confectioner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of a congregation (especially that of a church or synagogue)

examples.en: Every congregant stood up in unison to sing the final hymn of the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 每位聚会者都齐刷刷地站起来，唱响周日礼拜的最后一首赞美诗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congregant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 临睡前喝的酒, 睡帽
lemmas.def_en: an alcoholic drink taken at bedtime; often alcoholic

examples.en: Before retiring to his quiet bedroom, he poured himself a small bourbon as a nightcap.
examples.zh: 在回安静的卧室就寝前，他给自己倒了一小杯波旁威士忌作为睡前酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightcap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同义反复, 赘述, 重言式
lemmas.def_en: (logic) a statement that is necessarily true

examples.en: Saying that someone is a 'single bachelor' is an obvious grammatical tautology.
examples.zh: 说某人是“单身汉单身”显然是一种同义反复的语法语病。

lemmas.def_en: repetition of same sense in different words; ; ; - J.B.Conant

examples.en: `a true fact' and `a free gift' are pleonastic expressions
the phrase `a beginner who has just started' is tautological

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tautology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞机的引擎机舱, 飞机的驾驶员室, 吊篮
lemmas.def_en: a streamlined enclosure for an aircraft engine

examples.en: Engineers carefully inspected the turbine nacelle for any signs of internal mechanical wear.
examples.zh: 工程师们仔细检查了涡轮发动机机舱，以排查内部是否有机械磨损迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nacelle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the form of empiricism that bases all knowledge on perceptual experience (not on intuition or revelation)

examples.en: Logical positivism asserts that only empirically verifiable statements are meaningful and valid.
examples.zh: 逻辑实证主义坚称，只有能被经验验证的陈述才是有意义和有效的。

lemmas.def_zh: 实证论者, 实证主义者
lemmas.def_en: someone who emphasizes observable facts and excludes metaphysical speculation about origins or ultimate causes

examples.en: As a strict positivist, he rejected any theories that lacked measurable empirical proof.
examples.zh: 作为一名严格的实证主义者，他拒绝任何缺乏可衡量实证的理论。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 实在法学派, 实证主义者, 实证论者
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to positivism

examples.en: As a strict positivist, he rejected any theories that lacked measurable empirical proof.
examples.zh: 作为一名严格的实证主义者，他拒绝任何缺乏可衡量实证的理论。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to positivism

examples.en: positivist thinkers
positivist doctrine

family_guide.root_logic: 以 positivism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pathological egotist

examples.en: The dictator was a dangerous megalomaniac who believed he could conquer the entire world.
examples.zh: 这位独裁者是个危险的狂妄自大狂，自以为能征服全世界。

lemmas.def_en: a psychological state characterized by delusions of grandeur

examples.en: His blatant megalomania alienated him from everyone on the executive board.
examples.zh: 他狂妄自大的夸大狂倾向让他疏远了执行董事会的所有人。

lemmas.def_en: suffering from megalomania

family_guide.root_logic: 以 megalomaniac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾向自我宣传的人, 裸露症患者
lemmas.def_en: someone with a compulsive desire to expose the genitals

examples.en: Wearing outrageous neon costumes, he behaved like a desperate exhibitionist seeking online attention.
examples.zh: 他穿着怪异的荧光服装，活像个拼命在网上博眼球的爱出风头者。

lemmas.def_zh: 自我宣传癖, 裸露癖, 喜出风头癖
lemmas.def_en: extravagant and conspicuous behavior intended to attract attention to yourself

examples.en: His constant boastful posts on social media seemed like pure online exhibitionism.
examples.zh: 他在社交媒体上频繁发帖炫耀，看起来完全是在网上博眼球。

lemmas.def_en: compulsively attracting attention to yourself especially by public exposure or exaggerated behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exhibitionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long narrow sled without runners; boards curve upward in front

examples.en: The children pulled their wooden toboggan up the snowy hill for another fast ride.
examples.zh: 孩子们把木制平底雪橇拉上积雪的山坡，准备再滑一次。

lemmas.def_zh: 坐平底雪橇滑行；暴跌，骤降
lemmas.def_en: [I] To slide down a snow-covered hill on a toboggan; to fall or drop sharply.

examples.en: The children pulled their wooden toboggan up the snowy hill for another fast ride.
examples.zh: 孩子们把木制平底雪橇拉上积雪的山坡，准备再滑一次。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toboggan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating or belonging to the class Cephalopoda

examples.en: The giant octopus is a remarkably intelligent marine cephalopod capable of solving complex mazes.
examples.zh: 巨型章鱼是一种非常聪明的海洋头足动物，能够破解复杂的迷宫。

lemmas.def_en: marine mollusk characterized by well-developed head and eyes and sucker-bearing tentacles

examples.en: The giant octopus is a remarkably intelligent marine cephalopod capable of solving complex mazes.
examples.zh: 巨型章鱼是一种非常聪明的海洋头足动物，能够破解复杂的迷宫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cephalopod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any particle that obeys Fermi-Dirac statistics and is subject to the Pauli exclusion principle

examples.en: Unlike bosons, each fermion in a quantum system obeys the Pauli exclusion principle.
examples.zh: 与玻色子不同，量子系统中的每个费米子都遵循泡利不相容原理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fermion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mollusk with a low conical shell

examples.en: The clingy politician acted like a desperate limpet, refusing to step down from power.
examples.zh: 那个死缠烂打的政客就像个甩不掉的粘人精，坚决不肯下台。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 limpet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large dark low cloud

examples.en: A thick blanket of gray stratus covered the valley, blocking out all sunlight.
examples.zh: 厚厚的一层灰色层云笼罩了整个山谷，遮挡住了所有的阳光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stratus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可归还的, 应交还的
lemmas.def_en: that may be returned

examples.en: You will receive a small refund when you take these returnable glass bottles back.
examples.zh: 当你把这些可退还的玻璃瓶送回去时，会得到一小笔退款。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能退还的,(容器)不能退给卖主的
lemmas.def_en: that may not be returned

examples.en: nonreturnable bottles cannot be exchanged for a deposit
sale merchandise is nonreturnable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 returnable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预先录制，预先录音（或录像）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To record sound, television programs, or other material in advance before broadcasting or using it.

examples.en: The radio host decided to prerecord the holiday broadcast so he could visit family.
examples.zh: 电台主持人决定事先录制节日广播，以便能回家探望亲人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prerecord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （自行车等）滑行，不用脚踩骑行；随心所欲，不受拘束地行事
lemmas.def_en: [I] To travel downhill or forward on a bicycle without pedaling; to live or act freely without strict controls.

examples.en: He stopped pedaling and let his bicycle freewheel smoothly down the gentle slope.
examples.zh: 他停止蹬踏板，任由自行车顺着平缓的斜坡平稳地惯性滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freewheel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to bend or curve backward or in the opposite direction

examples.en: The horns of this ancient goat breed gracefully recurve over its powerful shoulders.
examples.zh: 这种古老山羊的角优雅地向后弯曲，延伸至其强壮的肩部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recurve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being at least 100 years old

examples.en: The cheerful centenarian celebrated her hundredth birthday surrounded by four generations of loving family.
examples.zh: 这位开朗的百岁老人在四世同堂的家人陪伴下庆祝了百岁寿辰。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is at least 100 years old

examples.en: The cheerful centenarian celebrated her hundredth birthday surrounded by four generations of loving family.
examples.zh: 这位开朗的百岁老人在四世同堂的家人陪伴下庆祝了百岁寿辰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 centenarian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: acting to neutralize acid (especially in the stomach)

examples.en: After eating the spicy curry, she chewed an antacid tablet to soothe her heartburn.
examples.zh: 吃完辛辣的咖喱后，她嚼了一片抗酸药来缓解胃部烧灼感。

lemmas.def_en: an agent that counteracts or neutralizes acidity (especially in the stomach)

examples.en: After eating the spicy curry, she chewed an antacid tablet to soothe her heartburn.
examples.zh: 吃完辛辣的咖喱后，她嚼了一片抗酸药来缓解胃部烧灼感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antacid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 成对物, 偶极天线, 对称振子, 偶极子, 对偶物
lemmas.def_en: a man's close-fitting jacket; worn during the Renaissance

examples.en: In historical linguistics, the words 'fragile' and 'frail' form an interesting etymological doublet.
examples.zh: 在历史语言学中，“fragile”和“frail”构成了一对有趣的词源对偶词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doublet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (从其他人口分出或构成总人口的)分组人口
lemmas.def_en: a population that is part of a larger population

examples.en: Researchers analyzed a specific subpopulation of patients who showed resistance to the new drug.
examples.zh: 研究人员分析了对这种新药表现出耐药性的特定患者亚群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subpopulation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an extinct arthropod that was abundant in Paleozoic times; had an exoskeleton divided into three parts

examples.en: The museum displayed an exceptionally well-preserved trilobite fossil found in ancient marine limestone.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一具在古老海洋石灰岩中发现的、保存完好的三叶虫化石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trilobite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (biology/medicine) to absorb something again, especially a fluid or substance back into tissues or the bloodstream

examples.en: The kidneys work continuously to filter blood and reabsorb essential water and nutrients.
examples.zh: 肾脏持续工作以过滤血液，并重新吸收必需的水分和营养物质。

lemmas.def_zh: 重吸收, 重吸收作用
lemmas.def_en: the organic process in which the substance of some differentiated structure that has been produced by the body undergoes lysis and assimilation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reabsorb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: periodic shedding of the cuticle in arthropods or the outer skin in reptiles

examples.en: During their seasonal moult, the birds lose old feathers and appear unusually quiet.
examples.zh: 在季节性蜕羽期间，鸟类会脱落旧羽毛，显得格外安静。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (British English spelling of molt) When an animal or bird moults, it sheds old feathers, skin, hair, or a shell.

examples.en: During their seasonal moult, the birds lose old feathers and appear unusually quiet.
examples.zh: 在季节性蜕羽期间，鸟类会脱落旧羽毛，显得格外安静。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moult 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使气馁，使沮丧，使萎靡不振
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (usually passive) To make someone lose enthusiasm, energy, or hope.

examples.en: Repeated failures to secure funding began to dispirit even the most passionate researchers.
examples.zh: 屡次未能获得资助，开始让即使是最热情的科研人员也感到气馁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dispirit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出租车司机, 出租马车的车夫
lemmas.def_en: someone who drives a taxi for a living

examples.en: The friendly London cabby navigated through dense traffic while recommending great local restaurants.
examples.zh: 那位友善的伦敦出租车司机一边在拥堵的车流中穿行，一边推荐很棒的当地餐馆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the present occasion

examples.en: The author coined a clever nonce word specifically for this futuristic science fiction story.
examples.zh: 作者专为这部未来科幻小说创造了一个巧妙的临时词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nonce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rare soft silvery metallic element; occurs in small quantities in sphalerite

examples.en: Indium is a critical component used in the production of modern touchscreens.
examples.zh: 铟是制造现代触摸屏的关键原料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slender freshwater fishes of Eurasia and Africa resembling catfishes

examples.en: The small loach hid quietly among the riverbed pebbles to avoid hungry predators.
examples.zh: 那条小泥鳅静静地藏在河床卵石间以避开饥饿的捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: desk or stand with a slanted top used to hold a text at the proper height for a lecturer

examples.en: The nervous professor gripped the wooden lectern tightly before beginning his keynote address.
examples.zh: 紧张的教授在开始主题演讲前紧紧抓住了木制讲台。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lectern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 心脏的跳动, 热情, 柔情, (美)(非正式)情人
lemmas.def_en: an object of infatuation

examples.en: The young actor quickly became an international heartthrob after starring in the romantic drama.
examples.zh: 这位年轻演员主演那部浪漫爱情剧后迅速成为了风靡全球的万人迷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartthrob 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 点人头数总人数, 职员总数
lemmas.def_en: number of people in a particular group

examples.en: The company plans to reduce its overall headcount to lower operating expenses this quarter.
examples.zh: 该公司计划在本季度削减总员工人数以降低运营开支。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headcount 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental

examples.en: By pure happenstance, the two childhood friends reunited at an airport in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 纯属偶然，这两位儿时玩伴在东京的一家机场重逢了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 happenstance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thin porridge (usually oatmeal or cornmeal)

examples.en: The poor prisoners were fed a meager bowl of watery gruel every morning.
examples.zh: 可怜的囚犯们每天早晨只分得一小碗稀粥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gruel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface

examples.en: The ancient painted ikon was carefully preserved behind protective glass in the cathedral.
examples.zh: 那尊古老的彩绘圣像被精心保存在大教堂的防护玻璃后。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ikon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used in the treatment of cancer

examples.en: Scientists are testing a promising new anticancer drug derived from deep-sea marine sponges.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在测试一种从深海海绵中提取的极具前景的新型抗癌药物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anticancer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (used colloquially) having the relationship of friends or pals

examples.en: They became remarkably pally after spending a few intense weeks working on the project.
examples.zh: 一起为这个项目紧张工作了几周后，他们的关系变得非常亲密。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pally 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (喻)敲诈勒索的放债者, 冷酷无情的商人, 冷酷无情的人, 夏洛克
lemmas.def_en: someone who lends money at excessive rates of interest

examples.en: The ruthless shylock demanded exorbitant interest rates from desperate local business owners.
examples.zh: 那个冷酷的放高利贷者向走投无路的当地企业主索要极高的利息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shylock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a writer who composes speeches for others to deliver

examples.en: The president met privately with his lead speechwriter to refine the annual address.
examples.zh: 总统与他的首席演讲稿撰写人私下会面，以润色年度讲话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speechwriter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 苏丹的职务, 苏丹统治的领土
lemmas.def_en: country or territory ruled by a sultan

examples.en: The peaceful sultanate relies heavily on oil exports to fund its social programs.
examples.zh: 这个和平的苏丹国主要依靠石油出口来资助其社会福利项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sultanate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coins collectively

examples.en: In ancient times, international trade debts were settled strictly in gold and silver specie.
examples.zh: 在古代，国际贸易债务完全是用金银硬币结算的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 specie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浑身湿透的, 饱含的, (因沉湎于酒而)迷糊的
lemmas.def_en: wet through and through; thoroughly wet

examples.en: After walking through the heavy rainstorm, his boots were completely sodden and heavy.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨中走过之后，他的靴子彻底湿透且沉重不堪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sodden 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of small fragments considered as a whole

examples.en: The dropped porcelain vase shattered into smithereens against the hard kitchen floor tiles.
examples.zh: 掉落的瓷花瓶砸在坚硬的厨房地砖上摔成了碎片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smithereens 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lighted by sunlight; ; - Wallace Stegner

examples.en: A sleeping cat stretched lazily across the bright sunlit rug in the living room.
examples.zh: 一只熟睡的猫在客厅洒满阳光的地毯上懒洋洋地伸展着身体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunlit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 将军职位, 将军政治, 幕府时代
lemmas.def_en: a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)

examples.en: Japan experienced relative peace and extreme isolation under the rule of the Tokugawa shogunate.
examples.zh: 在德川幕府的统治下，日本经历了相对的和平与极端的闭关锁国。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shogunate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the theory and practice of navigation through air or space

examples.en: Advances in astronautics have made commercial space tourism a practical reality today.
examples.zh: 航天学的进步使商业太空旅行在今天成为了现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astronautics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long wooden bench with a back

examples.en: She relaxed comfortably on the antique velvet settee while reading her favorite novel.
examples.zh: 她舒服地靠在古董丝绒长靠背椅上读着她最喜欢的小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 settee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: permanently attached to a substrate; not free to move about

examples.en: Barnacles are sessile marine creatures that spend their adult lives permanently anchored to rocks.
examples.zh: 藤壶是一种无柄海洋生物，成年后终生固定在岩石上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sessile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 怪人, 疯子, 内曲线球
lemmas.def_en: a whimsically eccentric person

examples.en: Nobody took his wild conspiracy theories seriously because they thought he was a screwball.
examples.zh: 没人把他的离奇阴谋论当真，因为大家都觉得他是个怪人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 screwball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (击剑中)还击, 机敏的回答
lemmas.def_en: a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)

examples.en: She delivered a brilliant riposte that instantly silenced her loud critic.
examples.zh: 她做出了精彩的反驳，立刻让喧闹的批评者闭了嘴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 riposte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To grow again after being cut, damaged, or lost, or cause something to do so.

examples.en: Certain lizards can regrow their tails after escaping from dangerous predators.
examples.zh: 某些蜥蜴从危险的捕食者口中逃脱后能重新长出尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 regrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [体]短网拍墙球,手球式墙球(比赛规则和场地都与有四面墙场地的墙手球相同,但击球用以皮带拴腕的短柄球拍,球较墙手球略大而软)
lemmas.def_en: the ball used in playing the game of racquetball

examples.en: They play racquetball at the local gym every Tuesday after work.
examples.zh: 他们每周二下班后都会在当地健身房打美式壁球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 racquetball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 古代不列颠或威尔士的王侯,首领
lemmas.def_en: the supreme war chief of the ancient Britons

examples.en: The legendary pendragon united the rival British tribes against invading forces.
examples.zh: 这位传奇首领团结了相互竞争的不列颠部落，共同对抗外敌入侵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pendragon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闺房, 内室, 花托
lemmas.def_en: large egg-shaped structures of grey matter that form the dorsal subdivision of the diencephalon

examples.en: Sensory information passes through the thalamus before reaching the cerebral cortex.
examples.zh: 感觉信息在到达大脑皮层之前会先经过丘脑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thalamus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of something having the yellowish green color of Chartreuse liqueur

examples.en: She wore a vibrant chartreuse silk dress to the summer gala.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件鲜艳的黄绿色丝绸连衣裙参加了夏日晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chartreuse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: combination of lenses at the viewing end of optical instruments

examples.en: He adjusted the telescope eyepiece to get a sharper view of Mars.
examples.zh: 他调整了望远镜目镜，以便更清晰地观察火星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyepiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the principal Christian church building of a bishop's diocese

examples.en: Tourists gathered in the square to admire the grand Florence duomo.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在广场上，欣赏宏伟的佛罗伦萨大教堂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 duomo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a low heavy horse cart without sides; used for haulage

examples.en: Heavy wooden barrels were loaded onto the horse-drawn dray yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天早上，沉重的木桶被装上了这辆马拉运货货车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dray 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 商业主义, 商业精神, 利润第一主义, 商业习惯, 商业用语
lemmas.def_en: transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services)

examples.en: The excessive commercialism of the holidays has ruined their traditional spirit.
examples.zh: 节日过度的商业化已经破坏了其传统的精神内涵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commercialism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sharp steel wedge that precedes the plow and cuts vertically through the soil

examples.en: The farmer sharpened the steel colter before plowing the dry field.
examples.zh: 农民在耕翻干涸的田地前磨利了钢制犁刀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 牧民的, 牧歌的, 乡下风味的
lemmas.def_en: (used with regard to idealized country life) idyllically rustic

examples.en: The painting depicted a bucolic landscape with grazing sheep and rolling hills.
examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了一幅吃草的羊群与起伏山丘构成的田园风光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bucolic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 四重的, 四倍的, 四垒的
lemmas.def_en: four times as great or many

examples.en: The company reported a fourfold increase in net profits this fiscal year.
examples.zh: 该公司报告称本财年净利润增长了四倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fourfold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a nonmetallic heavy volatile corrosive dark brown liquid element belonging to the halogens; found in sea water

examples.en: Bromine is a reddish-brown liquid that readily evaporates at room temperature.
examples.zh: 溴是一种红棕色液体，在室温下极易挥发。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chemistry) To treat or combine a chemical compound with bromine or a bromate.

examples.en: The technician will bromate the organic compound to prepare it for laboratory testing.
examples.zh: 技术员将对该有机化合物进行溴化处理，以便进行实验室检测。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bromine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 男修道院院长, 神父
lemmas.def_en: a French abbot

examples.en: The visiting abbe delivered an inspiring sermon at the village church.
examples.zh: 来访的神父在乡村教堂发表了一场感人至深的布道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abbe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally high acidity (excess hydrogen-ion concentration) of the blood and other body tissues

examples.en: Severe dehydration can cause metabolic acidosis, requiring immediate medical intervention.
examples.zh: 严重脱水可导致代谢性酸中毒，需要立即就医处理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acidosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肾上腺素能的, 释放出肾上腺素的
lemmas.def_en: relating to epinephrine (its release or action)

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an adrenergic drug to help dilate the patient's airways.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种肾上腺素能药物来帮助扩张患者的气道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adrenergic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having carbon atoms linked in open chains

examples.en: The chemist synthesized a new aliphatic hydrocarbon in the research laboratory.
examples.zh: 这位化学家在研究实验室中合成了一种新的脂肪族碳氢化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aliphatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a desire for bloodshed

examples.en: The tyrant's relentless bloodlust terrified everyone throughout the conquered kingdom.
examples.zh: 暴君无休止的杀戮欲使被征服王国内的每一个人都胆战心惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodlust 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 最低声部, 男低音歌手
lemmas.def_en: an adult male singer with the lowest voice

examples.en: The renowned basso sang the operatic aria with deep and resonant authority.
examples.zh: 这位著名的男低音歌手以深沉洪亮的威严之声演唱了这首咏叹调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 basso 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自高自大的人, 花花公子
lemmas.def_en: a man who is much concerned with his dress and appearance

examples.en: He was dismissed as an arrogant fop obsessed with expensive French fashion.
examples.zh: 他被斥为一个痴迷于昂贵法国时尚的傲慢花花公子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or happening in a river

examples.en: Fluvial processes shaped the wide valley over millions of years of sediment deposition.
examples.zh: 河流作用在数百万年的泥沙沉积过程中塑造了这个宽阔的山谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fluvial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 风刮的, 被风吹扫的, 暴露在风中的
lemmas.def_en: open to or swept by wind

examples.en: We walked along the windswept coast while harsh gusts tore at our heavy coats.
examples.zh: 我们在饱受风吹的海岸边漫步，狂风猛烈地扯着厚重的大衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windswept 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未点燃的, 无灯光的
lemmas.def_en: not set afire or burning

examples.en: He hesitated before stepping into the unlit alley where darkness obscured every corner.
examples.zh: 在踏入连个角落都看不清的无灯小巷前，他犹豫了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unlit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 横档, 横楣, 横梁
lemmas.def_en: a window above a door that is usually hinged to a horizontal crosspiece over the door

examples.en: Morning sunlight poured through the glass transom above the heavy wooden front door.
examples.zh: 晨光透过厚重木质前门上方的玻璃横窗倾泻而入。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by unusual lightness and delicacy

examples.en: The dancer wore a gossamer veil that fluttered gracefully with her every movement.
examples.zh: 舞者戴着轻盈飘逸的面纱，随着她的每一个动作翩翩起舞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gossamer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: light from a torch or torches

examples.en: The explorers advanced through the dark cave guided only by flickering orange torchlight.
examples.zh: 探险家们仅凭摇曳的橙色火把光芒，在黑暗的洞穴中前行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 torchlight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an aromatic gum resin obtained from various Arabian or East African trees; formerly valued for worship and for embalming and fumigation

examples.en: The sweet, resinous aroma of burning frankincense filled the ancient stone sanctuary.
examples.zh: 焚烧乳香散发出的甘甜树脂香气弥漫在古老的石头圣殿中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frankincense 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To manufacture or grow more goods or food than customers want or can buy.

examples.en: Factories tend to overproduce goods when they misjudge consumer demand in the market.
examples.zh: 当工厂误判市场消费需求时，往往会导致产品生产过剩。

lemmas.def_en: too much production or more than expected

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overproduce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (art) To paint, draw, or engrave using thousands of tiny dots rather than solid lines.

examples.en: The artist used a fine ink pen to stipple delicate shadows across the portrait.
examples.zh: 艺术家用一支细墨水笔通过点画法为肖像画勾勒出细腻的阴影。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stipple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 解开，理顺（缠结物）；使摆脱，脱离（纠葛）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To separate things that have become twisted or knotted together; to free oneself or someone from an entangled situation.

examples.en: It took her several patient minutes to disentangle the knotted gold necklace completely.
examples.zh: 她耐心地花了数分钟才将那条打结的金项链完全解开。

lemmas.def_en: the act of releasing from a snarled or tangled condition

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disentangle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 感光性的, 对光敏感的
lemmas.def_en: sensitive to visible light

examples.en: Certain medications can make your skin unusually photosensitive to direct summer sunlight.
examples.zh: 某些药物会使你的皮肤对夏季直射的阳光异常敏感。

lemmas.def_en: sensitivity to the action of radiant energy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photosensitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] ('it behooves someone to do') (formal) To be right, proper, or necessary for someone to do something.

examples.en: It would behoove you to review the contract carefully before signing your name.
examples.zh: 在签字之前，你理应仔细审阅一遍合同。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 behoove 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [微]病毒(成熟)粒子,毒粒,病毒体
lemmas.def_en: (virology) a complete viral particle; nucleic acid and capsid (and a lipid envelope in some viruses)

examples.en: Each infectious virion consists of genetic material enclosed within a protective protein shell.
examples.zh: 每个具有感染性的病毒粒子都由包裹在保护性蛋白外壳内的遗传物质组成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 virion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large tall chimney through which combustion gases and smoke can be evacuated

examples.en: Thick gray plumes billowed steadily from the factory smokestack into the morning sky.
examples.zh: 灰黑色的浓烟从工厂烟囱中源源不断地涌向清晨的天空。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smokestack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who sells wine

examples.en: The local vintner explained how oak barrels influence the complex flavor of wine.
examples.zh: 当地酒商解释了橡木桶是如何影响葡萄酒复杂风味的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vintner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

examples.en: A vintage motorcar rumbled down the cobblestone street, drawing admiring glances from tourists.
examples.zh: 一辆老式汽车轰鸣着驶过鹅卵石街道，引来游客们赞赏的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motorcar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who sponsors someone (the godchild) at baptism

examples.en: She asked her childhood friend to serve as a godparent to her newborn son.
examples.zh: 她邀请儿时的好友担任自己刚出生儿子的教母。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 godparent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷溜走，躲躲闪闪
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ around/about) To move around or hide secretly in shadows, especially with sinister or cowardly intent.

examples.en: Suspicious figures were seen skulking near the abandoned warehouse late last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚深夜，有人看见可疑的人影在废弃仓库附近偷偷潜伏。

lemmas.def_zh: 隐躲起来的人, 偷懒的人
lemmas.def_en: someone shirking their duty by feigning illness or incapacity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skulk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a serving of drink (usually alcoholic) drawn from a keg

examples.en: After a grueling day at work, his favorite tipple was a dry gin martini.
examples.zh: 在一天辛苦的工作后，他最喜欢的饮品是一杯干金马天尼酒。

lemmas.def_en: someone who drinks liquor repeatedly in small quantities

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tipple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 搅乱，扰乱；搅浑，使（液体）翻滚浑浊
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To make a liquid cloudy or muddy by stirring up sediment. 2. To agitate, disturb, or throw someone or something into disorder.

examples.en: Heavy thunderstorms began to roil the calm surface of the mountain lake.
examples.zh: 猛烈的雷暴开始搅动高山湖泊原本平静的水面。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 翻腾的；浑浊的；动荡不安的
lemmas.def_en: moving in a churning, violent, or turbulent manner; agitated
lemmas.usage_note: 多修饰翻滚的水流、乌云或尘土（roiling waters / clouds），引申可指动荡动乱的情势或情绪。

examples.en: The small boat struggled against the roiling waters of the river.
examples.zh: 小船在翻滚湍急的河水中艰难前行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To observe and identify wild birds in their natural environment as a hobby.

examples.en: They often wake before dawn to birdwatch along the quiet wetlands outside town.
examples.zh: 他们经常在黎明前醒来，前往城外宁静的湿地一带观鸟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birdwatch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: enclosed yard where cattle, pigs, horses, or sheep are kept temporarily

examples.en: Cattle were herded into the dusty stockyard to await transport to distant markets.
examples.zh: 牛群被赶进尘土飞扬的牲畜围栏，等待被运往遥远的市场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stockyard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance (as a coenzyme) that must join with another to produce a given result

examples.en: Zinc serves as an essential cofactor for many enzymes in the human body.
examples.zh: 锌是人体内许多酶的重要辅助因子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cofactor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (formal) To begin again after an interruption or pause.

examples.en: The committee decided to recommence the interrupted peace talks early next week.
examples.zh: 委员会决定下周初重新开始中断的和平谈判。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新开始, 重头再做
lemmas.def_en: beginning again

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recommence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指秘密或匆忙地）逃走，溜走；拔营，撤营
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (often + to/with) To leave a place suddenly and secretly, often to escape or with stolen goods. 2. [I] To pack up and leave a camp.

examples.en: The dishonest cashier managed to decamp overnight with all the stolen money.
examples.zh: 那个不诚实的出纳员携带着全部赃款连夜潜逃了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decamp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使目眩，使眩目；使陶醉，使迷乱
lemmas.def_en: [T] To greatly impress, confuse, or overpower someone with brilliance, bright light, or splendor.

examples.en: The glittering lights and lavish costumes will definitely bedazzle the entire audience.
examples.zh: 璀璨的灯光和奢华的服装一定会让所有观众为之倾倒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedazzle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to be sold in greater quantities than something else

examples.en: Our latest smartphone model continues to outsell its rivals across global markets.
examples.zh: 我们最新的智能手机型号在全球市场上继续比竞争对手畅销。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outsell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the tissue (covered by mucous membrane) of the jaws that surrounds the bases of the teeth

examples.en: Bleeding gingiva is often an early warning sign of severe gum disease.
examples.zh: 牙龈出血往往是严重牙龈疾病的早期预警信号。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the gums

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gingiva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development

examples.en: She possessed an inborn musical talent that amazed all of her teachers.
examples.zh: 她拥有一种令所有老师都赞叹不已的先天音乐才能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inborn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a brittle grey crystalline element that is a semiconducting metalloid (resembling silicon) used in transistors; occurs in germanite and argyrodite

examples.en: Early transistors were primarily manufactured using crystals of the element germanium.
examples.zh: 早期的晶体管主要是使用元素锗的晶体来制造的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 germanium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 温室, 玻璃工场, 禁闭房
lemmas.def_en: a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions

examples.en: Tropical plants thrive inside the heated glasshouse even during freezing winter months.
examples.zh: 即使在寒冷的冬季，热带植物在供暖的温室里也能茁壮成长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glasshouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: American finch whose male has yellow body plumage in summer

examples.en: A colorful goldfinch perched delicately on the sunflower to eat the ripe seeds.
examples.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的红额金翅雀轻巧地栖在向日葵上吃成熟的种子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goldfinch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 血液透析, 血液渗析
lemmas.def_en: dialysis of the blood to remove toxic substances or metabolic wastes from the bloodstream; used in the case of kidney failure

examples.en: Patients with chronic kidney failure usually require hemodialysis three times a week.
examples.zh: 慢性肾衰竭患者通常需要每周接受三次血液透析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemodialysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拦劫行人的强盗行为, 劫盗, 停顿, 索高价
lemmas.def_en: robbery at gunpoint

examples.en: A sudden mechanical failure caused an unexpected holdup on the assembly line.
examples.zh: 突发的机械故障导致装配线上出现了意想不到的停顿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holdup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平凡的, 单调的, 令人厌烦的
lemmas.def_en: not challenging; dull and lacking excitement

examples.en: She dreamed of world travel to escape her humdrum daily office routine.
examples.zh: 她梦想去环游世界，以摆脱日常办公室工作的单调乏味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humdrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 唤雨巫师, 人工雨工作者
lemmas.def_en: executive who is very successful in bringing in business to his company or firm

examples.en: The company hired a veteran rainmaker to bring in valuable new corporate clients.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一位资深的业务开拓骨干，以带来宝贵的新企业客户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rainmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象要倒的, 摇晃的, 放荡的
lemmas.def_en: in deplorable condition

examples.en: The poor family lived in a ramshackle wooden cabin near the riverbank.
examples.zh: 那户贫困人家住在河岸边一栋摇摇欲坠的简陋木屋里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramshackle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various shrubs and small trees of the genus Gardenia having large fragrant white or yellow flowers

examples.en: The sweet and heavy fragrance of a blooming gardenia filled the entire porch.
examples.zh: 盛开的栀子花散发出的浓郁清香飘满了整个门廊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gardenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an electrical phenomenon whereby an electromotive force (EMF) is generated in a closed circuit by a change in the flow of current

examples.en: Engineers carefully measured the coil's inductance to ensure the circuit functioned properly.
examples.zh: 工程师仔细测量了线圈的电感，以确保电路正常工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inductance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: greenhouse shrub with glossy green leaves and showy fragrant rose-like flowers; cultivated in many varieties

examples.en: The garden looked spectacular when the bright red japonica burst into full bloom.
examples.zh: 当鲜红的日本山茶花盛开时，花园看起来格外壮观。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 japonica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a game in which numbered balls are drawn at random and players cover the corresponding numbers on their cards

examples.en: He marked ten lucky numbers on his card while playing keno tonight.
examples.zh: 他今晚玩基诺彩票时，在卡片上标出了十个幸运数字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Eurasian plant with small white flowers yielding caraway seed

examples.en: The baker sprinkled freshly crushed caraway seeds over the traditional rye bread loaf.
examples.zh: 面包师在传统的黑麦面包上撒了新鲜压碎的葛缕子籽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caraway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting or originating in the inner ear

examples.en: Tourists easily lost their sense of direction within the old city's labyrinthine alleys.
examples.zh: 游客们在这座老城错综复杂的迷宫般的小巷里很容易迷失方向。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 labyrinthine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an aromatic oil that smells like lemon and is widely used in Asian cooking and in perfumes and medicines

examples.en: The chef added fresh lemongrass to give the spicy soup a refreshing citrus aroma.
examples.zh: 厨师加入了新鲜的柠檬草，使辣汤带有一股清新的柑橘香气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lemongrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地名辞典, 公报作者
lemmas.def_en: a journalist who writes for a gazette

examples.en: The scholar consulted an old geographical gazetteer to locate the forgotten historical settlement.
examples.zh: 学者查阅了一本古老的地名辞典，以寻找那座被遗忘的历史聚落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gazetteer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 壕, 沟渠, 护城河
lemmas.def_en: ditch dug as a fortification and usually filled with water

examples.en: Archaeologists recently discovered an ancient fosse dug to protect the Roman military camp.
examples.zh: 考古学家最近发现了一条用于保护罗马军营的古老壕沟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fosse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flat-bottomed volcanic crater that was formed by an explosion; often filled with water

examples.en: The shallow lake formed inside a prehistoric volcanic maar thousands of years ago.
examples.zh: 这个浅水湖形成于数千年前的史前低平火山口内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: weighs 115-126 pounds

examples.en: The young bantamweight fighter trained relentlessly to capture the world championship belt.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的雏量级拳手刻苦训练，誓要夺取世界拳王金腰带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bantamweight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by catatonia especially either rigidity or extreme laxness of limbs

examples.en: Shocked by the sudden tragedy, the patient remained in a catatonic state for hours.
examples.zh: 因突如其来的悲剧受到过度惊吓，患者数小时内一直处于紧张症木僵状态。

lemmas.def_en: extreme tonus; muscular rigidity; a common symptom in catatonic schizophrenia

examples.en: The patient slipped into deep catatonia and became completely unresponsive to sound.
examples.zh: 病人陷入了深度紧张症，对声音完全没有反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catatonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 本生（1811 - 1899, 德国化学家）；本生灯
lemmas.def_en: German chemist who with Kirchhoff pioneered spectrum analysis but is remembered mainly for his invention of the Bunsen burner (1811-1899)

examples.en: The chemistry teacher demonstrated how to adjust the flame on the Bunsen burner.
examples.zh: 化学老师演示了如何调节本生灯的火焰大小。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bunsen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迂回的, 间接的, 绕行的
lemmas.def_en: marked by obliqueness or indirection in speech or conduct

examples.en: They took a circuitous mountain route to avoid the heavy traffic on the highway.
examples.zh: 为了避开高速公路上的拥堵，他们绕道走了一条蜿蜒的山路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circuitous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用杂酚油涂抹（木材等），用防腐油处理
lemmas.def_en: [T] To treat or coat wood with creosote to protect it from rot.

examples.en: Workers will creosote the wooden railway sleepers to protect them from rot and decay.
examples.zh: 工人们将用杂酚油处理木质枕木，以防止其腐烂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 creosote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲打，碰击，轻击（尤指打在头上）；（英，俚）与……发生性关系
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (informal) To hit or bump against something, especially on the head. 2. [I, T] (British informal) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 3. [I] (endurance sports) To suffer sudden extreme exhaustion.

examples.en: He bragged to his friends that he managed to bonk his neighbor last night.
examples.zh: 他向朋友吹嘘昨晚和邻居发生了关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bonk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the category of nouns serving as the indirect object of a verb

examples.en: In this German sentence, the pronoun must be changed into the dative case.
examples.zh: 在这个德语句子中，该代词必须转化为与格形式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （登山中）用安全绳系牢，保护；（航海中）把缆绳拴在系索栓上
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (climbing / nautical) To secure a climbing rope or ship's line around a pin or device to hold someone or something safely.

examples.en: The experienced climber showed his partner how to belay properly during the ascent.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的攀岩者向同伴示范了在攀登过程中如何正确保护拴绳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 自体固有的, 正型结构的
lemmas.def_en: derived from organisms of the selfsame individual

examples.en: The surgeon recommended an autologous blood transfusion to minimize the risk of infection.
examples.zh: 外科医生建议进行自体输血，以最大程度降低感染风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autologous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a natural opening or perforation through a bone or a membranous structure

examples.en: The major nerve passes directly through this small foramen in the skull base.
examples.zh: 主神经直接穿过颅骨基部的这个小孔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foramen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 穷困, 贫穷, 缺乏
lemmas.def_en: a state without friends or money or prospects

examples.en: Years of relentless war plunged millions of ordinary citizens into sheer destitution.
examples.zh: 连年不断的战争使数百万普通平民陷入极度贫困之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 destitution 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance

examples.en: He listened intently in the darkness, but could not hear aught besides the wind.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗中凝神细听，但除了风声之外什么也没听见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aught 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尊崇为神, 神化, 美化
lemmas.def_en: model of excellence or perfection of a kind; one having no equal

examples.en: The grand cathedral stands as the ultimate apotheosis of medieval European architecture.
examples.zh: 这座宏伟的大教堂堪称中世纪欧洲建筑的登峰造极之作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apotheosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a state of inactivity (in business or art etc)

examples.en: The sudden increase in foreign investment pulled the national economy out of the doldrums.
examples.zh: 外资的突然注入使国家经济彻底摆脱了长期的低迷状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doldrums 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tourism to exotic or threatened ecosystems to observe wildlife or to help preserve nature

examples.en: The local government actively promotes ecotourism to preserve wildlife habitats and forests.
examples.zh: 当地政府大力推广生态旅游，以保护野生动物栖息地和森林。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ecotourism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: usually good-naturedly mischievous

examples.en: The mischievous little boy smiled with an elvish charm that melted everyone's heart.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的小男孩露出精灵般迷人的微笑，融化了大家的心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elvish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 传阅的, 广泛传送的
lemmas.def_en: intended for wide distribution

examples.en: The Pope issued a major encyclical letter addressing modern environmental protection issues worldwide.
examples.zh: 教皇发表了一份重要的通谕，探讨全球现代环境保护议题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encyclical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溶解, 病势减退, 消散
lemmas.def_en: recuperation in which the symptoms of an acute disease gradually subside

examples.en: The new antibiotic causes rapid bacterial lysis, effectively stopping the severe infection.
examples.zh: 这种新抗生素能促使细菌迅速裂解，从而有效遏制严重感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being or thrown out of equilibrium

examples.en: An imbalanced diet lacking vital nutrients can lead to chronic health issues later.
examples.zh: 缺乏必需营养素的失衡饮食可能导致日后出现慢性健康问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imbalanced 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a deliberately misleading fabrication

examples.en: The rumor regarding the company's sudden bankruptcy proved to be a malicious canard.
examples.zh: 关于该公司突然破产的传闻被证实是一个恶意的谣言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: involving a partial or full reversal of gender

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized psychological and medical counseling for transgendered young adults.
examples.zh: 该诊所为跨性别青年提供专业的心理和医疗咨询服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transgendered 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: admission to a group (especially a college or university)

examples.en: High school seniors are studying late every night to prepare for their final matric.
examples.zh: 高三学生每天晚上都学到深夜，为最终的高考做准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large semi-evergreen tree of the East Indies; trunk exudes a tenacious gum; bitter bark used as a tonic; seeds yield an aromatic oil; sometimes placed in genus Melia

examples.en: Our coastal hiking tour will take us past the historic headland at Neem.
examples.zh: 我们的沿海徒步之旅将带我们途经尼姆角具有历史意义的岬角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: membranous tube with cartilaginous rings that conveys inhaled air from the larynx to the bronchi

examples.en: A small piece of hard candy accidentally got stuck in the child's windpipe.
examples.zh: 一颗小硬糖不慎卡在了那个孩子的食管里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windpipe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可动摇的, 坚定不移的
lemmas.def_en: marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable

examples.en: Despite fierce criticism from rivals, she maintained an unshakable faith in her plan.
examples.zh: 尽管受到对手的猛烈批评，她仍对自己的计划坚信不疑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unshakable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inclination contrary to the strongest or prevailing feeling

examples.en: Swimmers were repeatedly warned about the strong undertow near the rocky shore.
examples.zh: 游泳者屡次受到警告，要当心靠近岩岸处的强劲回流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undertow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蒸汽集材机, 集材绞盘机
lemmas.def_en: (used only in combinations) the height or length of something in yards

examples.en: The logging crew used a powerful yarder to pull heavy timber uphill.
examples.zh: 伐木工人使用大功率集材机将沉重的木材拉上山坡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yarder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a reckless impetuous irresponsible person

examples.en: Everyone in the office laughed at his latest madcap scheme to get rich.
examples.zh: 办公室里的每个人都对他最新想出的发财闹剧付之一笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 madcap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: South American wood sorrel cultivated for its edible tubers

examples.en: The Andean farmer harvested fresh oca tubers to sell at the local market.
examples.zh: 那位安第斯农民收获了新鲜的酢浆薯，准备拿到当地集市上卖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 只有部分时间被雇用的, 就业不充分的
lemmas.def_en: employed only part-time when one needs full-time employment or not making full use of your skills

examples.en: Many recent college graduates find themselves underemployed in low-wage retail positions.
examples.zh: 许多应届大学毕业生发现自己大材小用，只从事着低薪的零售工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underemployed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large number or amount

examples.en: Her wealthy uncle always brought oodles of expensive gifts whenever he visited.
examples.zh: 她富有的叔叔每次来访总会带来大量的贵重礼物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oodles 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有三边的, 三方之间的
lemmas.def_en: involving three parties

examples.en: The three neighboring nations finally signed a historic trilateral security agreement yesterday.
examples.zh: 这三个邻国昨日终于签署了一项具有历史意义的三方安全协议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trilateral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣服磨薄了的, 穿旧了的, 衣着褴褛的, 俗套的, 乏味的
lemmas.def_en: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse

examples.en: He refused to throw away the threadbare coat because of sentimental memories.
examples.zh: 出于情感怀念，他舍不得扔掉那件磨得发白的大衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 threadbare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [英口]最高领导人, 总裁, 首脑
lemmas.def_en: the most important person in an organization

examples.en: The newly appointed media supremo announced major reforms to modernise the network.
examples.zh: 新上任的媒体巨头宣布了重大改革，以实现广播网的现代化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supremo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small East Indian shrubby mint; fragrant oil from its leaves is used in perfumes

examples.en: The rich, earthy fragrance of patchouli filled the entire boutique shop.
examples.zh: 广藿香浓郁朴实的香气弥漫了整家精品店。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patchouli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有点下流的, 近乎淫猥的, 伤风败俗的, 败坏风俗的, 有伤风化的
lemmas.def_en: suggestive of sexual impropriety

examples.en: The comedian received mixed reactions after telling a rather risqué joke on television.
examples.zh: 那位喜剧演员在电视上讲了个稍显低俗的笑话后，观众反响不一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 risque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: must be kept sacred

examples.en: In this traditional household, the evening family dinner was considered completely sacrosanct.
examples.zh: 在这个传统家庭中，晚间的家庭聚餐被视为绝对不容侵犯的规矩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sacrosanct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a contagious skin infection caused by the itch mite; characterized by persistent itching and skin irritation

examples.en: The doctor quickly diagnosed the persistent itchy rash as a case of scabies.
examples.zh: 医生很快将这种持续发痒的皮疹确诊为疥疮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scabies 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the imposition of a new organization; organizing differently (often involving extensive and drastic changes)

examples.en: A sudden management shakeup left many employees feeling deeply uncertain about the future.
examples.zh: 管理层突如其来的大改组让许多员工对未来感到深切不安。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shakeup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small house where smoke is used to cure meat or fish

examples.en: Pork ribs are slowly cured inside the traditional brick smokehouse out back.
examples.zh: 猪肋排在屋后传统的砖砌熏制室里慢慢被熏熟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smokehouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being so overabundant that prices fall

examples.en: An unexpected oversupply of crude oil caused global fuel prices to drop sharply.
examples.zh: 原油的意外供过于求导致全球燃料价格大幅下跌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oversupply 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with the least delay

examples.en: Please submit all required documents at the soonest to avoid any delays.
examples.zh: 请尽早提交所有必需文件，以避免任何延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soonest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行太空行走，进行舱外活动
lemmas.def_en: [I] To move or perform tasks outside a spacecraft in outer space.

examples.en: Two experienced astronauts will spacewalk tomorrow to replace an old communication antenna.
examples.zh: 两名经验丰富的宇航员明天将进行太空行走，以更换旧通信天线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spacewalk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 罗嗦, 冗词, 措辞
lemmas.def_en: overabundance of words

examples.en: The editor removed unnecessary verbiage to make the technical report more concise.
examples.zh: 编辑删去了多余的废话，使技术报告更加简明扼要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verbiage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颚骨, 下鄂的垂肉, 下鄂
lemmas.def_en: the jaw in vertebrates that is hinged to open the mouth

examples.en: The stern old professor rubbed his sagging jowl while reading the thesis.
examples.zh: 那位严厉的老教授在审阅论文时揉了揉下垂的下颌肉。

lemmas.def_zh: 下颚宽厚的, 有双下巴的
lemmas.def_en: having sagging folds of flesh beneath the chin or lower jaw

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jowl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not prudent or wise; ; - A.M.Schlesinger

examples.en: It would be imprudent to invest all your savings in a single stock.
examples.zh: 将所有积蓄全部投资于单只股票是极其不明智的。

lemmas.def_en: in an imprudent manner

examples.en: imprudently, he downed tools and ran home to make his wife happy

lemmas.def_zh: 轻率, 不小心, 鲁莽的行为
lemmas.def_en: a lack of caution in practical affairs

examples.en: His financial imprudence left him with mounting debts and very few savings.
examples.zh: 他在财务上的轻率鲁莽导致债务累积，几乎没有积蓄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imprudent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不吉的, 凶兆的, 恶运的
lemmas.def_en: not auspicious; boding ill

examples.en: Heavy dark rain clouds made for an inauspicious start to the wedding day.
examples.zh: 厚重的乌云为婚礼那天的开始蒙上了一层不祥的阴影。

lemmas.def_en: in an inauspicious manner

examples.en: he started his new job inauspiciously on Friday the 13th

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inauspicious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To make the physical movement and sound of vomiting, especially without actually bringing anything up.

examples.en: The foul chemical stench in the basement made the young cleaner retch violently.
examples.zh: 地下室刺鼻的化学恶臭让年轻的清洁工剧烈地干呕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a relatively flat highland

examples.en: Cattle grazed peacefully across the vast tableland under the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 牛群在蔚蓝天空下广袤的高地上悠闲地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tableland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ with) To mix or blend two or more substances, qualities, or groups together.

examples.en: The artist liked to intermix oil paints with sand to create texture.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家喜欢将油画颜料与沙子混合以营造质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intermix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 持续的, 不断的, 不停的
lemmas.def_en: continuing forever or indefinitely

examples.en: The unceasing noise from the highway kept him awake throughout the night.
examples.zh: 公路上持续不断的噪音让他整夜未眠。

lemmas.def_zh: 继续地, 不断地; 不已
lemmas.def_en: with unflagging resolve

examples.en: dance inspires him ceaselessly to strive higher and higher toward the shining pinnacle of perfection that is the goal of every artiste

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unceasing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾驰颠簸，摇晃狂奔；（船只）倾侧
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To rush forward swiftly and erratically, swaying or tilting from side to side out of control. 2. [I, T] (nautical) To tilt a ship onto its side for cleaning or repair.

examples.en: The car began to careen wildly down the steep and icy hill.
examples.zh: 汽车开始在陡峭结冰的山坡上失控倾斜疾驰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 careen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marrow squash plant whose fruit are eaten when small

examples.en: She sliced a fresh courgette into thin rounds for the pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 她切碎了一根新鲜西葫芦做意面酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 courgette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various small grey-and-black songbirds of North America

examples.en: A tiny chickadee perched on the snow-covered branch outside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 一只小山雀落在我卧室窗外积雪的树枝上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chickadee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who chooses or selects out

examples.en: Beggars cannot be choosers when resources are extremely limited during a crisis.
examples.zh: 在危机期间资源极其有限时，别无选择。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chooser 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 护柩者, 棺侧送葬者
lemmas.def_en: one of the mourners carrying the coffin at a funeral

examples.en: His oldest grandson served as a pallbearer during the solemn funeral service.
examples.zh: 他最大的孙子在庄严的葬礼上担任了护柩者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pallbearer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the various silver or gold coins of ancient Greece

examples.en: The museum displayed a rare gold stater minted during the ancient empire.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚古帝国时期铸造的罕见金币。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rectangular column that usually projects about a third of its width from the wall to which it is attached

examples.en: Each decorative pilaster along the hall added a touch of classical elegance.
examples.zh: 大厅里每一根装饰性壁柱都增添了一份古典的优雅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pilaster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To bury a dead body or remains in the ground again, especially in a different location.

examples.en: Archaeologists decided to rebury the ancient bones after completing their preliminary research.
examples.zh: 考古学家完成初步研究后决定重新埋葬这些古骨。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To bury someone or something again in the ground or in a tomb; (past tense and past participle of rebury).
the act of burying again

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebury 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 身无分文的, 穷光蛋的
lemmas.def_en: lacking funds

examples.en: I cannot join you for dinner tonight because I am completely skint.
examples.zh: 我今晚不能和你们一起吃晚饭，因为我彻底身无分文了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [地名] [保加利亚、俄罗斯] 斯沃博达
lemmas.def_en: (Russia) freedom

examples.en: We stopped for lunch in Svoboda before continuing our long road trip.
examples.zh: 在继续我们的长途公路旅行之前，我们在斯沃博达停下来吃午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 svoboda 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仰卧的, 掌心向上的, 懒散的
lemmas.def_en: lying face upward

examples.en: He lay supine on the warm grass, watching the summer clouds drift.
examples.zh: 他仰卧在温暖的草地上，看着夏日的云朵飘过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嫁妆, 天赋, 亡夫遗产
lemmas.def_en: money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage

examples.en: Under the old law, the widow was entitled to a customary dower.
examples.zh: 根据旧法律，这名寡妇有权获得一份习惯上的亡夫遗产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection containing a variety of sorts of things

examples.en: The festival offered a veritable smorgasbord of culinary delights from local vendors.
examples.zh: 该节日提供了由当地商贩带来的极其丰富的丰盛美食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smorgasbord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lean flesh of a fish similar to cod

examples.en: The chef pan-fried the fresh hake fillet with garlic and fragrant herbs.
examples.zh: 厨师用大蒜和香草香煎了新鲜的狗鳕鱼柳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of one of the paranasal sinuses

examples.en: Chronic sinusitis caused severe facial pain and made it very hard to breathe.
examples.zh: 慢性鼻窦炎导致面部剧烈疼痛，并让人呼吸十分困难。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sinusitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to a number system having 16 as its base

examples.en: Web designers use hexadecimal color codes to specify exact shades on screens.
examples.zh: 网页设计师使用十六进制颜色代码来精确指定屏幕上的色调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hexadecimal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 夫人, 太太, 已婚女子
lemmas.def_en: an Italian title of address equivalent to Mrs. when used before a name

examples.en: The polite waiter greeted the elegant signora at the restaurant door.
examples.zh: 礼貌的服务员在餐馆门口迎接这位优雅的夫人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signora 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 害羞地；羞怯地；胆怯地；小心地
lemmas.def_en: in a shy or timid or bashful manner

examples.en: The little girl smiled shyly behind her mother when strangers walked past.
examples.zh: 当陌生人走过时，小女孩怯生生地躲在母亲身后微笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shyly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large and noisy party of people

examples.en: They hosted a lively backyard shindig to celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary.
examples.zh: 他们举办了一场热闹的后院盛大派对来庆祝结婚十周年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shindig 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a toxic condition characterized by convulsions and possibly coma during or immediately after pregnancy

examples.en: The doctor monitored her high blood pressure closely to avoid maternal eclampsia.
examples.zh: 医生密切监测她的高血压以防止产妇发生惊厥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eclampsia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fearless daring

examples.en: Nobody had the temerity to question the strict rules set by management.
examples.zh: 没有人有胆量去质疑管理层制定的严格规定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 temerity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clergyman or other person in religious orders

examples.en: The respected churchman delivered an inspiring sermon on the power of forgiveness.
examples.zh: 这位备受尊敬的牧师就宽恕的力量发表了一篇鼓舞人心的布道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churchman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female tiger

examples.en: The fierce tigress stayed close to her cubs while watching the intruders carefully.
examples.zh: 凶猛的母虎寸步不离幼崽，警惕地注视着入侵者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tigress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the outcome of a complex sequence of events

examples.en: The novel's dramatic denouement tied together all the mysterious events from earlier chapters.
examples.zh: 这部小说的戏剧性结局将前面章节的所有神秘事件串联起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denouement 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 军需部, 给养, 军需部负责人
lemmas.def_en: a stock or supply of foods

examples.en: During the harsh winter campaign, the commissariat struggled to deliver adequate rations.
examples.zh: 在严酷的冬季战役中，军需部极力运送充足的口粮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commissariat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the art of making puppets and presenting puppet shows

examples.en: The traditional theater company preserved ancient forms of shadow puppetry through annual workshops.
examples.zh: 这家传统剧团通过年度工作坊保留了古老的皮影木偶艺术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puppetry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (music) a tremulous effect produced by rapid repetition of a single tone or rapid alternation of two tones

examples.en: She played the mandolin with a delicate tremolo that moved the entire audience.
examples.zh: 她用细腻的震音演奏曼陀林，感动了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tremolo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a vehicle with three wheels that is moved by foot pedals

examples.en: The little boy proudly rode his colorful trike along the garden path yesterday.
examples.zh: 小男孩昨天骄傲地沿着花园小径骑着他的彩色三轮车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难看的, 不优雅的, 粗陋的
lemmas.def_en: lacking grace in movement or posture

examples.en: The young flamingo looked ungainly as it stumbled across the shallow muddy water.
examples.zh: 年轻的火烈鸟在浅泥水中跌跌撞撞地走着，显得笨拙不雅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ungainly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To defeat someone completely in a fight, argument, or competition.

examples.en: Our skilled debating team managed to worst their opponents in the final round.
examples.zh: 我们技艺高超的辩论队在最后一轮彻底击败了对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 worsted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 礼拜堂牧师的职位或任期
lemmas.def_en: the position of chaplain

examples.en: She was appointed to the university chaplaincy after years of devoted community service.
examples.zh: 经过多年热忱的社区服务，她被任命为大学校牧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chaplaincy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or resulting from arbitration

examples.en: Both parties agreed to abide by the binding decision of the arbitral tribunal.
examples.zh: 双方均同意遵守仲裁法庭具有约束力的裁决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arbitral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (classical mythology) a serpent (or lizard or dragon) able to kill with its breath or glance

examples.en: Ancient legends warned that the mythical basilisk could turn living men into stone.
examples.zh: 古老传说警告说，神话中的蛇怪能将活人化作石头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 basilisk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 代书人, 公证人, 代笔人
lemmas.def_en: someone employed to make written copies of documents and manuscripts

examples.en: Before modern printing, the weary scrivener copied lengthy legal deeds by candlelight daily.
examples.zh: 在现代印刷术出现之前，疲惫的书吏每天在烛光下抄写冗长的法律契据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scrivener 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 起草人, 打样人, 制图员, (正式)制图能手
lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who draws plans of buildings or machines

examples.en: The chief draughtsman checked the architectural blueprints thoroughly before submitting them to builders.
examples.zh: 首席制图员在向施工方提交建筑蓝图前进行了仔细检查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 draughtsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an image represented as a two dimensional array of brightness values for pixels

examples.en: Zooming into the small bitmap image caused its edges to appear noticeably pixelated.
examples.zh: 放大这张小型位图图像会导致其边缘出现明显的像素化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bitmap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rounded like an egg

examples.en: The artist polished an ovoid stone until its smooth surface reflected the sunlight.
examples.zh: 艺术家打磨了一块卵形石头，直到其光滑的表面反射出阳光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ovoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to aquiculture

examples.en: Urban farmers built a modern hydroponic system to cultivate fresh greens without soil.
examples.zh: 城市农民建立了一套现代水耕系统，无需土壤即可培育新鲜蔬菜。

lemmas.def_en: a technique of growing plants (without soil) in water containing dissolved nutrients

examples.en: Urban farmers often rely on hydroponics to grow fresh greens without soil.
examples.zh: 城市农夫常常依靠水耕法在无土环境下种植新鲜蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydroponic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: French diplomat who in 1793 tried to draw the United States into the war between France and England (1763-1834)

examples.en: A spotted genet crept silently through the dark branches in search of beetles.
examples.zh: 一只斑点麝猫无声地穿过黑暗的树枝，寻找甲虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 genet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: noisy and mischievous merrymaking

examples.en: Their high jinks at the annual summer festival kept the whole neighborhood awake.
examples.zh: 他们在年度夏季庆典上的吵闹嬉戏让整个街区彻夜未眠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jinks 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: willful wanton and malicious destruction of the property of others

examples.en: Local police enforced strict measures to curb drunken hooliganism outside the crowded stadium.
examples.zh: 当地警方采取严格措施，以遏制拥挤体育场外的酒后流氓行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hooliganism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling lymph or lymphatic tissues

examples.en: Surgical doctors examined the patient's lymphoid tissue to check for signs of infection.
examples.zh: 外科医生检查了患者的淋巴组织，以排查感染迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lymphoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fabric made with yarn made from the silky hair of the Angora goat

examples.en: She knitted a warm, fluffy scarf using yarn spun from premium natural mohair.
examples.zh: 她用优质天然马海毛纺成的纱线织了一条温暖蓬松的围巾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mohair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: weighs no more than 115 pounds

examples.en: The agile flyweight surprised spectators with his incredible punching speed in round three.
examples.zh: 这位敏捷的次最轻量级拳手在第三回合以惊人的出拳速度震惊了观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flyweight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 摩洛神, 造成牺牲的事件
lemmas.def_en: a tyrannical power to be propitiated by human subservience or sacrifice; ; - Norman Douglas

examples.en: The brutal war became a moloch that devoured the lives of countless young soldiers.
examples.zh: 这场残酷的战争成了一个吞噬无数年轻士兵生命的恶魔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moloch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不注意, 粗心, 疏忽
lemmas.def_en: lack of attention

examples.en: A brief moment of inattention while driving can lead to a serious car accident.
examples.zh: 开车时片刻的疏忽就可能引发严重的交通事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inattention 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ancient Italian deity in human shape, with horns, pointed ears and a goat's tail; equivalent to Greek satyr

examples.en: The ancient marble statue depicted a playful faun holding a pair of wooden pipes.
examples.zh: 这尊古老的大理石雕像刻画了一个手持双木管的嬉戏农牧神。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: highly seasoned cut of smoked beef

examples.en: He ordered a hot pastrami sandwich with extra mustard at the traditional Jewish deli.
examples.zh: 他在那家传统犹太熟食店点了一份多加芥末的热熏牛肉三明治。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pastrami 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小丘, 小高处, 土堆
lemmas.def_en: a small natural hill

examples.en: They climbed the grassy hillock to get a better view of the sunset across the valley.
examples.zh: 他们爬上长满杂草的小土丘，以便更好地欣赏山谷另一侧的日落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hillock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用大车运送；费力搬运，运载
lemmas.def_en: [T] To carry or transport something heavy or cumbersome in a cart or with effort.

examples.en: Volunteers gathered every Saturday to cart away bags of trash from the community park.
examples.zh: 志愿者们每周六聚集在一起，用车将社区公园的垃圾袋运走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carting 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自炫博学的, 知识分子的, 不切实际的
lemmas.def_en: highly cultured or educated

examples.en: She usually avoids highbrow literary fiction, preferring fast-paced thrillers and light romance novels instead.
examples.zh: 她通常不读那些高深的严肃文学，更喜欢快节奏的惊悚片和轻言情小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highbrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any bird of the genus Pitta; brilliantly colored chiefly terrestrial birds with short wings and tail and stout bills

examples.en: Warm pitta bread is perfect for dipping into fresh hummus and seasoned garlic yogurt.
examples.zh: 刚烤热的皮塔饼非常适合用来蘸新鲜的鹰嘴豆泥和调味蒜香酸奶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pitta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small rounded structure; especially that at the end of the penis or clitoris

examples.en: The doctor examined the glans carefully to check for any signs of infection or swelling.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了阴茎头，以确认是否有任何感染或肿胀的迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glans 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食道, 咽喉, 排水沟, 海峡
lemmas.def_en: the passage between the pharynx and the stomach

examples.en: The hungry pelican swallowed the large fish whole down its remarkably expandable gullet.
examples.zh: 饥饿的鹈鹕把那条大鱼直接整条吞入了它极具延展性的食道中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gullet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who lends money at excessive rates of interest

examples.en: Desperate for cash, the merchant borrowed money from an unscrupulous moneylender at high interest.
examples.zh: 急需现金的商人以高额利息向一个不择手段的放贷者借了钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moneylender 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having an acceptable credit rating

examples.en: Banks are far more likely to grant lower interest rates to highly creditworthy borrowers.
examples.zh: 银行更有可能向信誉良好的借款人提供较低的贷款利率。

lemmas.def_en: trustworthiness with money as based on a person's credit history; a general qualification for borrowing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 creditworthy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不合时机的, 不巧的
lemmas.def_en: not opportune

examples.en: The unexpected power outage occurred at an extremely inopportune moment during the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 突如其来的停电发生在直播期间一个极不凑巧的时刻。

lemmas.def_en: at an inconvenient time

examples.en: he arrived inopportunely just as we sat down for dinner
she answered malapropos

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inopportune 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无弹性的, 无弹力的, 无适应性的
lemmas.def_en: not elastic

examples.en: The demand for essential life-saving medicine is famously inelastic regardless of price fluctuations.
examples.zh: 无论价格如何波动，针对基本救命药品的需求通常是极缺乏弹性的。

lemmas.def_zh: 无弹力, 生硬, 不适应性
lemmas.def_en: the lack of elasticity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inelastic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亵渎神明，说亵渎的话；肆意侮辱
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To speak irreverently or disrespectfully about God or sacred things.

examples.en: He warned his younger brother not to blaspheme by mocking the sacred traditions.
examples.zh: 他警告自己的弟弟不要嘲弄神圣的传统，以免犯下亵渎之罪。

lemmas.def_en: a person who speaks disrespectfully of sacred things

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blaspheme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: elaborately or excessively ornamented

examples.en: His florid complexion made him look perpetually flushed after climbing the steep staircase.
examples.zh: 爬完陡峭的楼梯后，他那红润的脸色让他看起来一直面色发红。

lemmas.def_zh: 华丽地, 浮华俗气地
lemmas.def_en: in a florid manner

examples.en: floridly figurative prose

family_guide.root_logic: 以 florid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a variety of plants grown indoors for decorative purposes

examples.en: She bought a low-maintenance houseplant to bring a touch of green into her office.
examples.zh: 她买了一盆容易照料的室内植物，想为办公室增添一抹绿意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 houseplant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (used informally) very small

examples.en: She accidentally dropped a weeny screw on the carpet and struggled to find it.
examples.zh: 她不小心把一颗极小的螺丝掉在地毯上，费了好大劲才找到。

lemmas.def_en: a smooth-textured sausage of minced beef or pork usually smoked; often served on a bread roll

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weeny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: refutation by example

examples.en: The researcher cited a compelling counterexample to disprove the long-held scientific theory.
examples.zh: 研究人员引用了一个令人信服的反例，推翻了长期以来的科学理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterexample 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (dated or literary) To suffer extreme hunger, or to cause someone to starve.

examples.en: The refugees were left to famish in the camp due to delayed emergency supplies.
examples.zh: 由于应急物资迟迟未到，难民们在营地里被迫挨饿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 famish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present

examples.en: The little girl gathered wildflowers to make a charming posy for her grandmother.
examples.zh: 小女孩采摘了许多野花，为祖母制作了一束迷人的小花束。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 posy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a domed or vaulted recess or projection on a building especially the east end of a church; usually contains the altar

examples.en: The colorful stained-glass window in the apse glowed brightly under the morning sun.
examples.zh: 教堂半圆形后殿上绚丽的彩色玻璃窗在晨光下熠熠生辉。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an apse

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To destroy or root out something completely, such as a disease, evil, or unwanted plant.

examples.en: The government launched a campaign to completely extirpate corruption from public offices.
examples.zh: 政府发起了一场彻底根除公职部门腐败的运动。

lemmas.def_zh: 消灭, 根除, 毁灭
lemmas.def_en: surgical removal of a body part or tissue

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extirpate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (biology) a taxonomic group with a single member (a single species or genus)

examples.en: The historic print shop preserved a functional Monotype machine for educational demonstrations.
examples.zh: 这家历史悠久的印刷厂保留了一台仍能运作的莫诺铸排机用于教学展示。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of only one type

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monotype 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing

examples.en: He packed his tactical vest, radio, and every necessary accoutrement for patrol.
examples.zh: 他收拾好了战术背心、无线电台以及巡逻所需的一切装备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accoutrement 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋转，回旋；（尤指跳舞时）扭动身体
lemmas.def_en: [I] To spin or rotate quickly in circles or spirals; to move one's body or hips in a circular motion.

examples.en: Dancers began to gyrate energetically as the upbeat music filled the hall.
examples.zh: 欢快的音乐响彻大厅，舞者们开始充满活力地旋转起舞。

lemmas.def_zh: 旋回, 回转, 旋转
lemmas.def_en: a single complete turn (axial or orbital)

examples.en: the plane made three rotations before it crashed
the revolution of the earth about the sun takes one year

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gyrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To place a layer, pad, or support underneath something.

examples.en: Workers carefully underlay the heavy stone slab with thick wooden blocks.
examples.zh: 工人们小心地用厚木块垫在沉重的石板下方。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past tense and past participle of underlay; supported from beneath.

examples.en: underlay the plate

lemmas.def_en: a pad placed under a carpet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underlay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贬低（人格、价值等），降低……的品格；使贬值，使降价
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to lower the moral value, respect, or quality of someone or something 2. [T] to lower the price or cost of something

examples.en: Using low-quality plastic materials will only cheapen the look of your product.
examples.zh: 使用劣质塑料材料只会降低你产品的档次。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheapen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 快速翻阅，翻动；洗（牌）；使起微波
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To turn over or flick through pages or cards quickly. 2. [T] To shuffle playing cards by flicking the corners together. 3. [I, T] To cause light waves or ripples on water.

examples.en: She began to riffle through the deck of cards before starting the game.
examples.zh: 在开始游戏前，她开始飞快地弹洗整副扑克牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 riffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a painful swelling of the bursa of the first joint of the big toe

examples.en: Tight shoes caused a painful bunion to develop on her left big toe.
examples.zh: 过紧的鞋子导致她的左大脚趾长出了疼痛的拇趾囊肿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bunion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 表现出，显露，流露（情感、品质等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To show or reveal a particular feeling, quality, or attitude clearly.

examples.en: Her latest paintings evince a deep understanding of natural light and shadow.
examples.zh: 她最新的画作展现出对自然光影的深刻理解。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evince 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 断断续续的, 一阵阵的, 间歇的
lemmas.def_en: occurring in spells and often abruptly

examples.en: Exhausted from travel, he fell into a fitful sleep interrupted by strange noises.
examples.zh: 旅途劳顿的他陷入了断断续续的睡眠，不时被奇怪的噪音打断。

lemmas.def_en: in a fitful manner

examples.en: he slept fitfully

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fitful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾听，留神听；追溯，回溯（与 back 连用）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (literary or archaic) To listen attentively and pay attention. 2. [I] ('harken back to') To recall or return to an earlier subject or time.

examples.en: Citizens gathered in the central square to harken to the mayor's annual address.
examples.zh: 市民们聚集在中心广场，倾听市长的年度演讲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder

examples.en: He stuffed a water bottle and a warm jacket into his canvas knapsack.
examples.zh: 他将水壶和一件保暖夹克塞进了帆布背包里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knapsack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (biology) similarity or identity of form or shape or structure

examples.en: The mathematician proved an unexpected isomorphism between the two distinct algebraic systems.
examples.zh: 这位数学家证明了这两个截然不同的代数系统之间存在意想不到的同构关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isomorphism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 运货马车车夫, 御夫(星)座, 北斗七星
lemmas.def_en: the driver of a wagon

examples.en: The weary wagoner guided his heavy team of horses along the muddy trail.
examples.zh: 疲惫的马车夫牵引着他沉重的马队沿着泥泞的小路前行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wagoner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) weather deck; the part of a ship's hull that is above the waterline

examples.en: Crew members gathered topside to enjoy the fresh sea breeze at sunset.
examples.zh: 船员们聚集在干舷甲板上，在日落时分享受清新的海风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the seed of flax used as a source of oil

examples.en: She adds a spoonful of ground flaxseed to her morning oatmeal every day.
examples.zh: 她每天都会在早晨的燕麦粥里加一勺磨碎的亚麻籽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flaxseed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (used informally) very small
